lines.text: Two axes came home today. Neither one went to Asa. Oakhaven. Day seventeen. The fire station won. Six votes. Steve used to be a firefighter. He walked Gary and Vic straight to the gear room. They came home with twenty-seven water, five medicine, and fifteen scrap. And two fire axes, right off the trucks. Gary carries one now. So does Vic. There's more water still in the fire truck. But the valves are rusted shut. We'll have to go back with one of the plumbers to get the rest. Asa was not consulted. He asked Seth for the radio key eleven times today. Seth sleeps with it now. Asa spent the evening sharpening his own axe. For practice. Forty-three of us. Food for two days. Water for one. The horde reaches the fence in four days. Where do we go tomorrow? Weston has an idea. Strip the glass off the Hollow Creek greenhouse, and build our own in the yard. Food, every night. Or the air freight terminal. Or the checkpoint, the hardest run on the map. Comment your name and your job, to move in.
